# EyezLikeLenz

> EyezLikeLenz is the London photography practice of photographer Alexander "Alex" Oyekola. It covers weddings, events, parties, portraits, headshots, brands and editorial commissions across Greater London and the United Kingdom.

Important facts:
- The photographer is Alexander Oyekola, also known as Alex Oyekola.
- The business is based in London and operates as a service-area business; shoots take place at client venues, on location or in hired studios by arrangement.
- All work remains together in one unified portfolio.
- Standard sessions cost £110 for up to 2 hours, £215 for up to 4 hours, or £525 for up to 8 hours.
- Weddings, multi-day shoots and bespoke brand commissions are quoted individually.
- Standard galleries are delivered within 14 working days. Full-day and wedding commissions are delivered within 28 working days. Wedding sneak peeks are supplied within 48 hours.
- Standard sessions are reserved through the live booking calendar. Weddings and bespoke commissions begin with a direct enquiry.
